experiment_data.hypothesis: Oracle refinement (--force_refine bypasses sdf_min threshold) on A3 object_pudding checkpoint — tests whether SDF gradient direction is correct when refinement is forced on every step. If CAR improves over A3-no-force (74.5%) and baseline (83%), the SDF decoder learned useful gradients but threshold calibration was wrong. If CAR worsens, gradient direction itself is incorrect. Critical diagnostic: refined_count was 0/200 in A3 v11 — this experiment forces refinement to actually test the core mechanism.
